references.title: 民法 §487: the employer’s delay in accepting the work leaves the wage owed; the day is not an absence.

description: An employer shutdown that stops work.

references.title: 職業安全衛生法 §36(2): 勞工於停工期間應由雇主照給工資.

description: A government order to stop work.

references.title: 天然災害發生事業單位勞工出勤管理及工資給付要點: not an absence and the attendance bonus untouched; the day’s wage may be withheld.

description: A natural disaster that interrupts work.

references.title: 勞資爭議處理法 §54; 民法 §482: no work, no wage for the strike days; not attended.

description: A strike stops work; participant pay follows the agreement.

references.title: 因應景氣影響勞雇雙方協商減少工時應行注意事項: days off unpaid, a monthly-paid full-time worker’s month never below the minimum wage; insurance and pension kept.

description: An agreed reduction of working time.
